episode_title: Kennedy Center Demolition Threat, Trump's Troubles, Poland Warns Of Russian Attacks
script_en: Kennedy Center Demolition Threat, Trump's Troubles, Poland Warns Of Russian Attacks.
A federal judge told President Trump he cannot demolish the Kennedy Center without 30 days’ notice, after the board shut the building and Trump threatened to rip it down if his name is not on it.

The president has taken a series of hits this week, from the Supreme Court blocking his mail-in voting plan to the Fed increasing interest rates against his wishes, raising questions about how much institutions are willing to push back as the midterms approach.

Poland’s prime minister says Russia is planning hybrid drone and missile attacks on European countries that support Ukraine, strikes Moscow would try to pass off as accidents to keep NATO from responding.
